name: Kawasaki Ninja ZX-6R
engine: 636 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's 636 supersport. 2024-2026 bikes are under a do-not-ride recall for the crankshaft bushing.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before anything else. 2024-2026 ZX-6Rs are in recall 25V798 (which replaced 25V376) for a crankshaft bushing that can seize. Kawasaki says not to ride affected bikes until the repair is done.
A-002.reason: The engine can lose power or seize while riding.

recalls.what: Crankshaft bushing can seize and stop the engine. Do not ride until repaired.
recalls.fix: Free dealer repair once Kawasaki releases it. Bikes fixed under 25V376 need the new repair too.
